SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (sales_line_id, return_ts_utc, quantity_returned, refund_net)) dist_combo, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) s USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
      SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) rn
      FROM fact_sales_line f) WHERE rn = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (f.channel_code = 'WB' AND w.web_order_id IS NULL AND s.store_id = 900)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period, cp.category,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS nlines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3

WITH wd AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
l AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) bd, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, f.quantity, f.channel_code, s.store_id, w.web_order_id wo, cp.category cur_cat, p.category asw_cat,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line g WHERE g.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND g.line_no=f.line_no) dupc
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
    LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cur_cat, asw_cat, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN dupc>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND wo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_nodispatch,
 ROUND(SUM(net_amount),2) net_raw, SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0 OR standard_cost<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd
FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.bd
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND (cur_cat IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR asw_cat IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
